findings.text: **Existing checks get overwritten** If an export already has `source_checks`, `contradictionsOf` overwrites it when any check lacks `n`. The object is copied first, then `own` replaces that field with `checks`. The original value disappears from both the mapped dataset and the residual data without a warning. Use a collision-safe name when preserving the checks, and add a test with both fields present.

tests.name: d) checks without a count n beside an existing source_checks: the source value is never overwritten, and the whole dataset is demoted with a diagnostic
